name: Utter North
title: Utter North: The Roof of the World
description: The Utter North is the northernmost reach of Faerûn, a land of glaciers, icebergs, and eternal winter where only the hardwarest creatures survive.
wiki: The Utter North encompasses the great glaciers of the High Ice and the Sea of Moving Ice. It is a region largely devoid of human settlement, though tribes of Frost Giants, orcs, and barbaric humans have been known to eke out an existence here.

popup.title: Sea of Moving Ice
popup.description: A collection of icebergs and frost-covered isles.

popup.title: The Great Glacier
popup.description: A massive sheet of ice covering the northeastern reach.
